description: Cheapest route to move tokens between chains (Ethereum to Base, Arbitrum to Solana…) across 20+ bridges via LI.FI: amount received, minimum, USD values, gas, bridge fees, total cost in percent, estimated time, steps and approval address; with fromAddress, the unsigned transaction to sign. Swaps on either side are included when the tokens differ. A quote only: nothing is signed or sent. Use before an agent moves funds across chains. Example: fromChain=ethereum, toChain=base, fromToken=USDC, amount=1000. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

amount.description: Amount of fromToken in token units, e.g. 100 or 0.5

fromAddress.description: Optional wallet that would send: adds the unsigned transaction to the answer

fromToken.description: Token to sell: symbol (USDC, ETH) or address

toAddress.description: Optional receiving wallet, e.g. a Solana address when bridging to Solana

toToken.description: Token to receive (default: the same token)

name: bridge_quote
title: Bridge quote, cross-chain transfer
